title: Woman did not believe husband had drugged her for rape by strangers, Manchester trial told
summary_full: Wife said to detectives: ‘I had no knowledge of what you told me had happened and I still can’t believe it’s true’A woman who was allegedly raped and sexually assaulted by men her husband invited to their home after he drugged her told police she could not believe it happened.In a video interview played to a jury at Minshull Street crown court in Manchester, she told detectives: “I had no knowledge of what you told me had happened and I still can’t believe it’s true, and I think you have made a mistake.” Continue reading...
